queries_run: McKesson CVS distribution agreement 2027 renewal OR second source OR in-house 2026

findings.claim: MCK FY2026 10-K：最大客戶 CVS 占營收約 24%、應收約 21%；前十大客戶占約 73%；與 CVS 的配銷合作已延至 2027 年 6 月。
findings.excerpt: Sales to our largest customer, CVS Health Corporation (“CVS”), accounted for approximately 24% of our total consolidated revenues in fiscal 2026. In fiscal 2023, we extended our pharmaceutical distribution partnership with CVS to June 2027.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：客戶可能減少採購或不續約，單一或多個大客戶減量、不續約可能對業務造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: Some of our customers from time to time reduce the amounts they purchase from us, do not renew their purchase contracts with us, renew their purchase contracts at less favorable terms, delay or default on their payments to us, or avoid payments to us through bankruptcy proceedings.

findings.claim: McKesson 於 2026-10-01 宣布與 CVS 就藥品配銷協議延長至 2032 年 6 月達成原則性協議（尚非最終合約）；Cardinal Health 亦與 CVS 延長至 2032 年 6 月。
findings.source: Distribution Strategy: McKesson Extends CVS Pharmaceutical Distribution Agreement Through 2032

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未發現 CVS 導入第二供應商或自製 MCK 配銷環節的來源；搜尋結果顯示 2026-10-01 MCK 宣布與 CVS 就延長至 2032 年 6 月達成原則性協議，Cardinal Health 同樣延長 CVS 合約至 2032（見 clues，未讀頁面原文）。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
